notes.title: BETTER EDITION now live (it's about time) and on SALE too!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7937509/eaa32c70119ed4d84cfce5f1f334de492244653b.gif

I finally got around to releasing the Better Edition : ) I've really tried to address all of the feedback the game received. I hope to add further improvements and content over time. I also want to add a speed run and treasure hunt mode. Below is a list of some of the new features and improvements. Thank you for playing and please spread the word. ːsteamhappyː

BETTER EDITION FEATURES
• Linux support
• Rebuilt the entire game from the ground up : )
• 25 unique Steam achievements
• Autosave, manual save options, and instant checkpoint loading
• Revamped menus and UI (such separate music and sfx volume controls)
• Lots of secrets and hidden story events
• Improved minigames
• More fluid movement and interactions
• New dynamic lighting system
• Revamped animations and graphics (pixel AA filtering and widescreen assets)
• Revamped controls and new moves - such as run and search inventory : )
• 50% funnier jokes

P.S. New trailer [strike]coming soon![/strike] out now : )

notes.title: Quick update on my new game Mayhem In Single Valley
notes.content:
I've been very busy developing my new game  Mayhem In Single Valley . I can confirm the game has player stats, basic crafting, a quest manager, a proper save option, plus some J.J. Abrams-esque secret stuff I can't speak about right now : )

If you haven't seen the  official homepage  yet, why not check it out? You'll discover screenshots, animation previews, teaser posters, a dev blog, and more. The game is turning out to me a mix between Undertale and The Last Of Us - seriously!

Enjoy - Brian

Ps New music and a early video demo coming soon!

notes.title: Thanks for the feedback so far!
notes.content:
I have read all the reviews (positive and negative - ouch!) so far. I thought I would share a list of improvements that I will be adding to the spiritual successor I am developing called  Mayhem In Single Valley. First off, everything in the You Are Not A Banana was made by one person (me) and there were many limitations in terms of time, resources, and know-how, when making my first game. However, for Mayhem In Single Valley I am working with a small team. We have decided to build the new game from the ground up so we can incorporate the following improvements based on your comments regarding YNB. 

A save option – as the game will be a lot longer and there will be lots more areas to explore/discover.
An inventory system (and hopefully some basic crafting).
Enemies and boss battles to keep you on your toes. 
A faster pace with more moves and environmental interactions.
An in-depth story with a variety of weird and wonderful fleshed out characters.
Stats based combat and character progression. 
A hint system for those trickier puzzles.
Lots of special level-up items, modes of transport, and mini games. 

Thank you for your support so far. More news and previews coming soon.
Happy gaming - Brian

notes.title: You Are Not A Banana has made it to Steam!
notes.content:
It's been quite the journey. Thanks to everyone who gave my game their vote on Greenlight. More than appreciated : )

By picking up a copy you are supporting the development of 'Mayhem In Single Valley' – a spiritual successor to You Are Not A Banana that contains many new features and improvements. More news and previews coming soon.

Don't forget to send me your thoughts on how you'd like to see the game evolve and I'll do my best to make it happen. 

- Brian
